sources.quote: Lambda Cancri is a blue-white-hued spectroscopic binary star in the zodiac constellation of Cancer.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.8 solar radii and 3.09 solar masses (FLAME) and 10,302 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
